'''Tech Two''' was a [[Void Jumper]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Marines]] who participated in the [[assault on the New Jedi Temple]]. The [[Technician/Legends|technician]] used a [[magclamp]] to affix a [[Electromagnetic pulse grenade/Legends|blinder]] to a [[vidcam]] in the [[New Jedi Temple]] while operating alongside [[Tech One]], [[Saba Sebatyne]], and [[Tahiri Veila]] to disable the surveillance system, as [[Abeloth]] had taken control of the [[Jedi Temple's computer core]].
